hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' 2>/dev/null); case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; if ! git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '(^|/)(AGENTS|CLAUDE)\.md$'; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"Convention checkpoint: no AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md is staged in this commit. If this change alters a build, test, commit, or architecture convention, update the relevant AGENTS.md (root for project-wide, or the nearest one for the area you touched) in THIS commit so the rules stay in sync. If nothing convention-level changed, proceed."}}'; fi ;; esac; exit 0
